UPDATE 2026-11-14 (first slice, dark behind EDITOR_CANVAS; split out and closed as PROG-E6A): pure gesture model in lib/builder/gesture.ts (long-press state machine, drop hit-test, reorder, Alt+Arrow keyboard twin) and a layer list on /pages/canvas with press-and-hold drag, keyboard and Up/Down button reorder. No real-device touch test has been run; the order is local, not saved. Still open: spacing handles, canvas drag, the nested layer tree, presets-first inserter on the canvas, wiring to a real document, and the phone gate.

2026-11-16 (SCAN-1207): evidence refresh. The 2026-10-05 line says no editor drag-drop exists; re-test the premise against components/page-editor before working this row. Parked until 2027-01-05.

UPDATE 2026-11-16 (PROG-E6B, direct manipulation on the real document, dark behind EDITOR_CANVAS): on the Space page draft that PROG-E5B wired to /pages/canvas, a move in the layer list is now saved; the layer list is a nested tree (rows, columns, blocks) with a keyboard and button path to every place on the page; the selected block has spacing handles that walk the document's named steps (space above, padding, space below) and can store nothing else; and blocks are added presets first, blank second. All of it rides the one draft write action and its revision guard. No migration. The canvas frame, which stayed empty in a real browser, now draws. Pictures of the real components on a fixture document are in /mnt/project-files/editor/e6b/. Of the list in the 2026-11-14 note, four are closed (spacing handles, the nested layer tree, the presets-first inserter on the canvas, wiring to a real document). Still open on this row: (1) drag across columns and rows, and drag on the canvas itself (today a drag reorders inside one column; across is Up, Down or the keyboard); (2) the frame draws only the selected block as plain words, so handles are not yet on a true render of the page; (3) rows and columns: add, remove, reorder, change the column count from the canvas; (4) remove, duplicate and hide a block from the canvas, and undo; (5) the live data sections (About, Offerings, Events) in the inserter, which needs the Space page builder's lock rule; (6) the keyboard model beyond moves (a roving focus through the tree, shortcuts); (7) the same controls in the website and Space builder shells; (8) the phone gate: the full authoring path on a real phone has not been run, and no save has been made from a browser against a database. 2026-11-17 BACKLOGGED TO NEXT WEEK (Daniel, 01:02Z: finish what is running, backlog everything else): items (3) rows (PROG-E6D), the page frame (PROG-E6E) and (5) live sections (PROG-E6F) are built. Held to the week of 2026-11-23, nothing started: dragging a block across columns and on the frame; (6) the roving keyboard focus and shortcuts; (7) the same controls in the website and Space builder shells; (8) the phone gate; and the picker field for live sections (which Offerings, Events, Team, Journeys or Circles a section features). EDITOR_CANVAS stays off, so none of this is on the launch path.

UPDATE 2026-11-18 (held items unblocked by Daniel; website builder, on the launch path, not behind EDITOR_CANVAS): item (6) for the website builder's Layers tree. The tree is one tab stop (a roving tabindex: the row last focused, else the selected block, else the first); Up and Down walk every row, nested blocks included; Home and End jump to the ends; Left goes to the block that holds this one and Right into its first block; Enter or Space selects. Row shortcuts match the section menu: Delete or Backspace removes (focus passes to the next row outside the removed block), Cmd or Ctrl and D duplicates, Cmd or Ctrl, Shift and H hides a top-level section on this device, Shift and C opens comments; Alt and an arrow still moves, now in the DAWN shell too. Rules are pure in lib/sites/editor/layer-focus.ts with tests; the shell wires them on the list around the rows (components/sites/editor/shell.tsx) with two shell tests. No migration. Still open on this row: the same roving focus on the /pages/canvas layer tree and in the Space page builder; shortcuts on the canvas frame itself; dragging a block across columns and on the frame; (7) the rest of the direct-manipulation controls in the website and Space builder shells; the picker field for live sections; and (8) the phone gate, plus a screen reader pass in a real browser.

UPDATE 2026-11-18 (second slice, website builder): a block now crosses columns in the website builder's Layers. Every column of a block shows its label, an empty one says it is empty, and a label takes a dragged block at the end of that column, so an empty column can be filled by drag (before, a drag could only land before another block, and an empty column had nothing to drop on). The keyboard twin is Alt and Right or Left on the focused row, which sends the block to the end of the neighbouring column; Alt and Left or Right is always taken on a row so the browser's Back never fires. Pure rule layerColumnTarget in lib/sites/editor/layer-focus.ts with tests; four shell tests in components/sites/editor/shell.layers.test.tsx measure what Save draft sends. No migration. Still open: dragging on the canvas frame itself (website and /pages/canvas), cross-column moves in the Space page builder and on /pages/canvas, a touch (long-press) path for the website Layers drag, and the phone gate.

UPDATE 2026-11-18 (third slice, website builder, on the launch path): the touch (long-press) path for the website Layers drag. HTML drag never starts from a finger, so a finger or a pen now holds a row still for LONG_PRESS_MS (the lib/builder/gesture.ts state machine), then drags; a move past the slop before it lands is a scroll and lets go. Once armed the page stops scrolling, the row or column label under the finger lights, and lifting drops there through the same moveBlockTo target the mouse drop uses: each landing place carries that target as data (lib/sites/editor/layer-touch.ts, with tests), so the two paths cannot drift. The click after a drag is not a pick, and the long-press menu is held off on a row. A mouse keeps the HTML drag. Wired once on the list around the rows (components/sites/editor/use-layer-touch-drag.ts); three shell tests in components/sites/editor/shell.layers.test.tsx measure what Save draft sends (into an empty column, a reorder inside a column, and a scroll or a mouse that moves nothing). No migration. Not yet run on a real phone: that stays in (8) the phone gate. Still open: dragging on the canvas frame itself, cross-column moves in the Space page builder and on /pages/canvas, and the phone gate.
